zh.title: 波音第三季交付161架商用飛機 737家族佔124架
zh.summary: 波音公佈第三季交付161架商用飛機；737家族交付124架，9月交付57架
body: 波音（Boeing）公佈第三季商用飛機交付數據。根據Aerospace Global News報導，波音確認第三季交付161架商用飛機，今年前九個月累計交付475架。
報導指出，737家族在交付結構中佔比最大。7月至9月底期間共交付124架737，今年前九個月累計交付367架。
單月數據方面，路透社報導指出，波音9月交付57架飛機，高於8月的51架，也高於去年同期的55架。
其他機型方面，波音第三季交付10架767（今年前九個月累計26架），777計畫在第三季交付5架，年初至今累計20架。
報導提到，波音國防、太空與安全部門第三季交付33架飛機，今年前九個月累計98架。該部門第三季交付內容包括7架KC-46加油機、3架新造AH-64阿帕契直升機與12架重製阿帕契直升機，另交付2架新造CH-47契努克、1架翻新契努克、2架F-15與2架F/A-18，以及1架MH-139與3枚商用及民用衛星。
與競爭對手比較，報導指出空中巴士（Airbus）第三季交付量比波音多35架。依空中巴士公佈的數據，該公司9月向37家客戶交付72架飛機，並錄得17架毛訂單；今年前九個月交付547架，客戶數84家。不過波音在9月訂單上領先，錄得165架毛訂單，競爭對手為17架。
訂單方面，報導指出，波音於9月30日確認衣索比亞航空（Ethiopian Airlines）同意購買8架777-8貨機與2架777貨機。報導稱這是衣索比亞航空第二度訂購777X家族，該公司先前已購買8架777-9客機。

en.title: Boeing delivers 161 commercial aircraft in Q3, 737 family accounts for 124
en.summary: Boeing confirms 161 commercial deliveries in Q3; 737 family contributes 124; September deliveries reach 57
body: Boeing has reported its third-quarter commercial aircraft delivery figures. According to Aerospace Global News, the manufacturer confirmed it delivered 161 commercial aircraft in the third quarter and 475 commercial deliveries in the first nine months of the year.

The 737 family accounted for the largest share of output, the report said. Between July and the end of September, 124 737s were delivered, while a total of 367 aircraft from the family were delivered in the first nine months of 2026.
On a monthly basis, Reuters reported that Boeing delivered 57 aircraft in September, up from 51 in August and 55 a year earlier.

For other programmes, 10 767 aircraft were delivered in the third quarter, taking the year-to-date figure for the type to 26. The 777 programme recorded five deliveries in the three months and 20 aircraft since the beginning of the year.

Boeing's Defence, Space & Security division delivered 33 aircraft in the third quarter, bringing its total to 98 deliveries in the first nine months of the year, the report said. Third-quarter deliveries for the division included seven KC-46 tanker aircraft, three new AH-64 Apache helicopters and 12 remanufactured Apaches, along with two new CH-47 Chinooks, one renewed Chinook, two F-15 models, two F/A-18 models, one MH-139 and three commercial and civil satellites.

The report said Airbus outdelivered Boeing by 35 aircraft in the third quarter. According to Airbus figures, it delivered 72 aircraft to 37 customers in September and recorded 17 gross orders, and made 547 deliveries to 84 customers in the first nine months of 2026. Boeing led in September orders with 165 gross orders, compared with 17 for Airbus, the report said.

On orders, Boeing confirmed on 30 September that Ethiopian Airlines had agreed to purchase eight 777-8 Freighters and two 777 Freighters, the report said. It described the order as Ethiopian Airlines' second for the 777X family, after the carrier previously purchased eight 777-9 passenger jets.

zh.title: SpaceX限制Starshield移動終端速度 烏克蘭部隊稱部分無人機任務取消
zh.summary: 烏克蘭官員稱，SpaceX限制Starshield移動終端速度，部分無人機任務因此取消。
body: 烏克蘭官員表示，SpaceX在夜間對使用Starshield軍用通訊服務、且處於移動中的終端實施速度限制，事前未作通知。烏克蘭總統Volodymyr Zelenskyy的顧問Serhiy Beskrestnov稱，移動中的Starshield終端限速為每小時100英里（160公里）。官員表示，飛行途中通訊中斷，導致部分無人機任務取消。
烏克蘭第7快速反應軍團告訴路透社，無人機飛行時，速度僅每小時110至120公里，連線也可能中斷10至20秒；該部隊表示，這使無人機更難操控。報導指出，相關限制涉及Starshield，不一定適用於在烏克蘭運作的所有Starlink終端。

en.title: SpaceX Speed Limits on Starshield Terminals Disrupt Ukrainian Drone Missions
en.summary: Ukrainian officials say SpaceX limits disrupted drone links and forced some mission cancellations.
body: SpaceX introduced speed restrictions overnight on terminals operating on its Starshield military service, without advance warning, according to Serhiy Beskrestnov, an adviser to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Beskrestnov said the limit for terminals in motion was 100 mph (160 km/h). Ukrainian officials said communications were interrupted in flight, forcing troops to cancel some drone missions.

Ukraine’s 7th Rapid Reaction Corps told Reuters that connections during flights could drop for 10–20 seconds at speeds of 110–120 km/h, making the drones harder to control. The report said the restrictions concern Starshield, rather than necessarily applying to every Starlink terminal operating in Ukraine.

zh.title: CMAC Group調查：57%需後續交通旅客自行安排地面接駁
zh.summary: CMAC Group調查發現，57%需要後續地面交通的旅客自行安排
body: CMAC Group的調查指出，在需要後續地面交通的航班中斷旅客中，57%自行安排交通。調查也發現，曾需要地面交通的受訪者中，96%至少遇到一項問題。
受訪者提到的問題中，等候時間長最常見，佔41%；交通費用高其次，佔37%。這項研究由Censuswide進行，調查1,250名曾在2026年6月至8月間經歷航班中斷的英國、法國、德國、希臘和西班牙受訪者。

en.title: CMAC Group survey finds 57% arranged their own onward ground transport
en.summary: CMAC Group research found 57% of passengers needing onward transport arranged it themselves.
body: Research by CMAC Group found that 57% of passengers who needed onward ground transport after flight disruption arranged it themselves. The study covered 1,250 disrupted passengers across Europe. Among passengers who needed ground transport, 96% encountered at least one problem.

Long waiting times were the most frequently reported issue, affecting 41% of respondents. High transport costs followed, affecting 37%. Censuswide conducted the research among 1,250 respondents who had experienced flight disruption between June and August 2026 in the UK, France, Germany, Greece and Spain.

zh.title: 美國議員要求暫停SMART空管系統，質疑上線前測試
zh.summary: 美國議員要求暫停SMART，追問上線前安全評估與人員訓練
body: 美國議員要求聯邦航空總署（FAA）暫停人工智慧空中交通管理系統SMART，並質疑係統在投入服務前是否經過充分測試。報導指出，SMART於9月21日在Ronald Reagan Washington National、Washington Dulles（IAD） International及Baltimore/Washington International機場開始運作。
議員致函交通部長及FAA署長，要求說明部署前進行的安全評估，並詢問空中交通管制員及其他航空人員是否接受足夠訓練。他們也詢問SMART是否曾針對惡劣天氣、設備故障及其他幹擾進行測試，以及既有安全審查要求是否遭到豁免。信件要求FAA於10月19日前回覆；報導稱，目前沒有事故被報告為歸因於SMART。

en.title: US lawmakers seek pause to SMART air traffic system over safety testing
en.summary: US lawmakers seek a SMART pause, questioning pre-deployment safety reviews and staff training
body: Twenty-five US lawmakers are calling on the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to suspend SMART, an AI-powered air traffic management system, while questioning whether it was adequately tested before entering service. SMART began operating on 21 September at Ronald Reagan Washington National, Washington Dulles (IAD) International and Baltimore/Washington International airports.

In a letter to the transportation secretary and FAA administrator, lawmakers sought details of safety assessments conducted before deployment and asked whether controllers and other aviation personnel had received sufficient training. They also asked whether SMART had been tested against severe weather, equipment failures and other disruptions, and whether established safety review requirements were waived. The letter gives the FAA until 19 October to respond. The report says no accidents have been reported as attributed to SMART.
